body: B07 consumer-graph audit (ac-02): codegraph_impact on sharpen_and_guard enumerated its 3 consumers — classify_fusion, classify_multi_branch, classify_multi_branch_with_enriched (the live multi-branch default + fusion paths). datetime_format_refinement was inserted at the value-based step (after value_sharpen, before sharpen_and_guard) in all three, so it runs unconditionally on every multi-branch/fusion classify regardless of header. The legacy classify_column (original value-classifier) path is NOT covered — it is the deprecated non-default path (v0.6.19 default is multi-branch). No signature changes; the rule only mutates ColumnResult in place like the other Sharpen rules. CI mirror green: fmt clean, clippy clean (core+model), finetype-model 458 tests pass, finetype-core datetime_format 17 tests + taxonomy-consistency pass.
